# graylog_index_sets (Data Source)

Lists all Graylog index sets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_index_sets" "all" {}

output "index_set_titles" {
  value = [for s in data.graylog_index_sets.all.index_sets : s.title]
}
```
